categories.description: Unplasticized PVC pipes for potable water supply, drainage, sewerage, and soil waste discharge.

standards.title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
standards.scope_text: This standard deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and structures. It covers design principles, material quality requirements, execution, quality control, and safety factors for reinforced concrete construction.
standards.abstract: Fourth revision of the primary Indian code of practice for plain and reinforced concrete design and structural safety.

amendments.change_summary: Modifications in maximum cement content and durability criteria in aggressive environments.
Revised criteria for high-strength concrete grades up to M100 and self-compacting concrete guidelines.

cross_references.description: High strength deformed steel bars for concrete reinforcement specified under Clause 5.6.
Mild steel and medium tensile steel bars for concrete reinforcement.
Methods of tests for strength of concrete (compressive and flexural strength).
General construction in steel; companion structural design code.

standards.title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
standards.scope_text: This standard covers the requirements for deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in three strength grades, Fe 415, Fe 500, and Fe 550, including corrosion resistant steel (CRS) grades.
standards.abstract: Primary product specification for TMT and high strength deformed rebars used across civil construction.

amendments.change_summary: Inclusion of Fe 600 strength grade and mandatory ductility parameters (ratio of UTS to YS).

cross_references.description: Design provisions for reinforced concrete using deformed bars.
Metallic materials - Tensile testing at ambient temperature.
Replaced hot rolled deformed bars standard IS 1139.

standards.title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel - Specification
standards.scope_text: This standard covers the requirements of structural steel including micro-alloyed steel plates, shapes, sections, flats and bars intended for use in structural steel work, bridges, transmission towers and general engineering applications.
standards.abstract: Comprehensive specification for hot rolled structural steel profiles including E250, E350, and sub-zero impact tested grades.

cross_references.description: Structural steel design code governing member sizing and connection design.
Superseded legacy structural steel standard IS 226.

standards.title: General Construction in Steel - Code of Practice
standards.scope_text: This code applies to general construction in steel using hot rolled steel sections and steel plates. It covers Limit State Design (LSD) approach for tension, compression, flexural, and combined stress members, connection details, and fatigue provisions.
standards.abstract: National code of practice for design and execution of structural steel buildings and frameworks.

cross_references.description: Material quality specification for structural steel sections.

standards.title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies - Specification
standards.scope_text: This standard specifies requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) pipes intended for potable water supplies, irrigation, and industrial applications. It covers pressure ratings, dimensions, mechanical performance, and toxicological safety requirements.
standards.abstract: Primary specification for uPVC pressure pipes used in water supply pipelines and municipal distribution.

cross_references.description: Specification for uPVC fittings for potable water supplies.
Method of test for hydrostatic pressure strength of uPVC pipes.

standards.title: Specification for Unplasticized PVC Solvent Cement for Joining uPVC Pipes and Fittings
standards.scope_text: This standard lays down requirements for solvent cements used for joining uPVC pressure pipes and fittings manufactured in accordance with IS 4985.
standards.abstract: Material performance and shear strength testing standard for solvent cement adhesives in water pipelines.

cross_references.description: uPVC pressure pipe specification requiring solvent cement joints.

standards.title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Fixed Electrical Installations - Specification
standards.scope_text: This standard specifies safety and performance requirements for manually operated AC switches with a rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and rated current not exceeding 63 A, intended for household and similar fixed electrical installations.
standards.abstract: Safety and endurance testing standard for flush/surface mounted wall switches in residential and commercial buildings.

amendments.change_summary: Updated testing requirements for LED load compatibility and flame retardancy of enclosure plastic.

cross_references.description: Plugs and socket-outlets of rated voltage up to 250V and rated current up to 16A.
PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to 1100 V.

standards.title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables for Working Voltages Up to and Including 1100 V
standards.scope_text: This standard covers single core and multicore PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables for electric power and lighting in domestic, commercial, and industrial installations.
standards.abstract: Mandatory standard for low voltage building wires and flexible cords used in electrical power distribution.

cross_references.description: Methods of test for electric cables (conductor resistance, insulation resistance, flame retardancy).

standards.title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
standards.scope_text: This standard specifies requirements for industrial safety helmets intended to protect the head against impact from falling objects and electrical shock in industrial workplaces.
standards.abstract: Mandatory safety standard for protective hard hats worn by personnel on construction and industrial sites.

amendments.change_summary: Enhanced penetration resistance test and flame exposure standards.

cross_references.description: Industrial safety belts and harnesses companion PPE standard.

standards.title: Personal Protective Equipment - Footwear - Part 2: Test Methods and Specifications for Safety Footwear
standards.scope_text: This standard specifies basic and additional (optional) requirements for safety footwear used for general industrial purposes, including toe impact resistance of 200 Joules, slip resistance, and penetration resistance.
standards.abstract: Harmonized safety footwear specification incorporating toecap strength, anti-static, and oil-resistant sole criteria.

certification_rules.description: Mandatory ISI certification under Steel & Steel Products (Quality Control) Order for all high strength deformed rebars.
Mandatory BIS certification for uPVC pipes used in municipal water supply networks.
Mandatory ISI mark under Electrical Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices Order.
Mandatory BIS certification for PVC insulated cables up to 1100V.
Mandatory ISI certification under Personal Protective Equipment Quality Control Order.
